Struct RectangleF

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Primitives
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

Stores a set of four floating-point numbers that represent the location and size of a rectangle. The code was duplicated from System.Drawing.RectangleF.

[Serializable]
public struct RectangleF : IEquatable<RectangleF>
